candidate.title: Evaluating the Utilities of Foundation Models in Single‐Cell Data Analysis
candidate.abstract: Foundation Models (FMs) have made significant strides in both industrial and scientific domains. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of FMs for single-cell sequencing data analysis through comprehensive experiments across eight downstream tasks pertinent to single-cell data. Overall, the top FMs include scGPT, Geneformer, and CellPLM by considering model performances and user accessibility among ten single-cell FMs. However, by comparing these FMs with task-specific methods, we found that single-cell FMs may not consistently excel than task-specific methods in all tasks, which challenges the necessity of developing foundation models for single-cell analysis. In addition, we evaluated the effects of hyper-parameters, initial settings, and stability for training single-cell FMs based on a proposed scEval framework, and provide guidelines for pre-training and fine-tuning, to enhance the performances of single-cell FMs. Our work summarizes the current state of single-cell FMs, points to their constraints and avenues for future development, and offers a freely available evaluation pipeline to benchmark new models and improve method development.
candidate.authors: Tianyu Liu, Kexing Li, Yuge Wang, Hongyu Li, Hongyu Zhao

extraction.method: scEval框架系统评测单细胞基础模型
extraction.data: 10个单细胞基础模型，8项下游任务
extraction.scenario: 单细胞数据分析模型评测
extraction.benchmark: 对比10个单细胞基础模型与任务专用方法
extraction.results: scGPT、Geneformer、CellPLM综合表现最佳；基础模型并非在所有任务上优于任务专用方法；评估超参数、初始设置与稳定性并给出预训练微调指南
extraction.limitations: 基础模型未全面超越任务专用方法，必要性存疑
extraction.summary: 本文系统评测单细胞基础模型在单细胞数据分析中的效用。通过scEval框架在8项下游任务上比较10个单细胞基础模型及任务专用方法，并考察超参数、初始设置与训练稳定性。发现scGPT、Geneformer、CellPLM综合最佳，但基础模型并非在所有任务上优于专用方法，并给出预训练与微调指南及公开评测流程。
